score_notes: Higher score is better. Token-hit values are fractions.
Domain scores are derived diagnostics using the same scorer; they are not additive contributions or separately evaluated panel identities.
Domain hit rates average trials; the selection score averages workload/capacity groups and includes a weakest-group term.
Registered baseline AST complexity is charged as zero; raw scores remove this asymmetry.
Train and probe trials do not affect validation selection scores.
